mapper.insert: INSERT INTO circle_explore_session (topic_id, owner_member_id, invite_code, status) VALUES (#{topicId}, #{ownerMemberId}, #{inviteCode}, 'ACTIVE')
INSERT IGNORE INTO circle_explore_session_member (session_id, member_id) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{memberId})
mapper.select: SELECT id, topic_id, owner_member_id, invite_code, status, create_time, completed_at FROM circle_explore_session WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, topic_id, owner_member_id, invite_code, status, create_time, completed_at FROM circle_explore_session WHERE invite_code = #{inviteCode} AND status = 'ACTIVE' LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM circle_explore_session_member WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND member_id = #{memberId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM circle_explore_session_member WHERE session_id = #{sessionId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO circle_explore_record (session_id, member_id, offer_id, supply_profile_id, note) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{memberId}, #{offerId}, #{supplyProfileId}, #{note})

INSERT INTO circle_explore_answer (session_id, member_id, answer_stage, answer_value) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{memberId}, #{answerStage}, #{answerValue}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE member_id = VALUES(member_id), answer_value = VALUES(answer_value), update_time = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.merchant_id) FROM circle_explore_record r JOIN merchant_chapter_offer o ON o.id = r.offer_id WHERE r.session_id = #{sessionId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM circle_explore_answer WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND answer_stage = #{stage}

SELECT r.*, o.merchant_id, p.supply_name, ch.circle_candidate_code, ch.name AS candidate_name FROM circle_explore_record r JOIN merchant_chapter_offer o ON o.id = r.offer_id JOIN merchant_circle_supply_profile p ON p.id = r.supply_profile_id JOIN cms_topic_chapter ch ON ch.id = o.chapter_id WHERE r.session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY r.recorded_at, r.id
mapper.update: UPDATE circle_explore_session SET status = 'COMPLETED', completed_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{sessionId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
